name: Customer order placement (multi-supplier)
findings: create_order does not emit OrderCreated event (Law 3 violation)
No multi-supplier splitting in order creation
Event subscribers are stubs with # Future: comments

name: Supplier payout
findings: generate_supplier_payout_batches does not emit PayoutCreated event (Law 3 violation)

name: Return and refund
findings: update_return_request does not emit RefundPosted event (Law 3 violation)
No rollback for refund already issued to gateway

name: Logistics pickup and delivery
findings: No ShipmentCreated event emitted via canonical event bus
Realtime updates use WebSocket hub, not domain events

name: Admin ledger posting and reconciliation
findings: create_journal_entry does not emit JournalEntryPosted event (Law 3 violation)

name: Customer registration and KYC
findings: accounts domain has no events.py or subscribers.py

name: Supplier onboarding and first product listing
findings: supplier_products_service reads catalog.products directly (possible Law 3 violation)
Product creation does not emit ProductCreated event
